newsitem.title: UK: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs at 64 last week.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Europe oil, gas rigs at 64 last week.

text.p: The number of active oil and gas rigs operating offshore Northwest Europe stood at 64 last week, consultants Arthur Andersen said.
There were 34 wells drilling in British waters and 14 in the Norwegian sector. The Netherlands had 11 rigs and Denmark four.

Arthur Andersen said in a weekly report that UK exploration spuds to date in 1997 were running 25 percent behind the corresponding period last year. Although exploration starts were down by 10 wells, appraisal levels were up by 10 over the same period. Total exploration and appraisal activity for both years was unchanged the same at 48 spuds.
